payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed information about the current state-of-the-art speech recognition systems on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) dataset, including specific models and their performance metrics.

claims.text: The current best model on WSJ is an HMM-based system that combines convolutional, recurrent, and fully connected layers, achieving the lowest Word Error Rate (WER).
A fully convolutional approach has been developed that matches the current state-of-the-art performance on WSJ, eliminating the feature extraction step.
Replacing traditional language models with convolutional ones has shown significant improvements in WER on WSJ.
